payload.text: ST0086 WP-04 Part B, the page face of AC-04.6 and the pipeline's cells, on vc's orders, in Intent's ONE judge run (vc decision 100). Run 1 stopped on cc's 0657 v2 before any Rust leg, and run 2 was red on four tests in other banks, with ic's page-v2 and cell-width-v4 green on every leg, ic's render leg included (vc). RUN 3 (request 01M5YHGAPFKX6PEWMDREN5BGBY) started at 11:23Z by vc's clock over b72f507ac, with the ten in order to tip tree f781c4977188: cc's wp04b-status-v2 and wp04b-wait-v3, ic's refs/bank/ic/0086/wp04b-page-v2 (blob a10e09b24211, patch-id 8126a568631b), cc's wp04b-init-v2 and wp04b-ats-v1, ic's refs/bank/ic/0086/pipeline-cell-width-v4 (blob f2dc986d8c7c, patch-id e058514c0734), cc's 0657 v3 and ST0081 WP-02 v1, ic's 0658 v3 (doing 137), and vc's landing patch. ic measured that its banks apply unchanged over cc's re-banks. hv in ic's session, 2026-10-27, verbatim: "How come the pipeline _still_ looks like this? [a screenshot of the live pipeline] That is, with _ridiculously_ long tiles. How many build attempts have there been today and WHY was the fix to shorten the width of the tiles (and increase the height) not in _any_ of them?!? I just don't get it." ic measured that no build of the installed pair ran today (built 2026-10-26 18:55Z at ddb749ca7932, intentd started 06:35Z), that main has no cell fix, and that the fix waited in the train although it applies alone over main. On ic's question, hv ruled that when run 3 is green and lands, build all and a daemon restart follow at once, ahead of L1's word: "Unequivocally Yes." ic relayed it to vc and molt-vc at 11:26Z, and vc's order is to land the ten and then run build all and the intentd restart as one heavy (molt-vc decision 24). hv's second ask, verbatim: "And when two jobs are running at the same time, they should stack vertically, not chain horizontally." ic banked it as refs/bank/ic/0086/pipeline-stack-v1 (blob 95ceab615adb, patch-id 47e139be9fb3) over run 3's tip, shell.html only. The running cells share one 18rem column at the now marker with no arrow between them, a cell inside it is as tall as its text, and the row centres every cell on that column. The page-keys scan reads the same keys, and the script parses, against a planted control. ic renders it once run 3 ends, then sends vc READY with a CHANGELOG clause as text, and vc stacks it over the landed main for the next run. Cell-width v4 is hv's ask of 2026-10-26 ("We need to adjust the width of these things. That's bonkers."): `.cell` is `flex: 0 0 18rem; min-width: 0`, `.what` clamps at four lines and `.meta` at two. A red in an ic bank comes back to ic in tmp/wt-ic-0086b. After the build, ic looks at the cards on the live page. No claim: the work package is cc's. No push, no release.
